# The clinvar feed

NCBI ClinVar variants of a gene panel.

Pathogenic and likely pathogenic ClinVar variants of a small gene panel (default BRCA1, BRCA2 and TP53, 200 variants a gene) as rows of the genomics module's variant kind: GRCh38 position and alleles, gene, consequence, impact, clinical significance, review status and conditions. One run is about ten requests.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | NCBI (National Library of Medicine) (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/) |
| Licence | [Public domain (NCBI data policy)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/): redistributable |
| Attribution | Contains data from NCBI ClinVar (public domain; NCBI asks that it is not presented as an NCBI endorsement) |
| Notes | ClinVar submissions are the submitters' own interpretations; NCBI asks for at most 3 requests a second without an API key (10 with one). |
| Lake | `genomicslake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 06:00 (local time) |
| Pull | `clinvar.ClinVarFeed` (tools/loaders/genomics/clinvar.py); 0.4 s between requests, 3 retries |
| Keys | `ncbi` from `${NCBI_API_KEY}` (optional) |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run clinvar --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run clinvar                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/clinvar/<date>/, load into genomicslake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status clinvar             # its last runs
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### variant

Pack `genomics`, kind `variant`, table `clinvar-variant`, key `VARIANT_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/clinvar/<date>/clinvar-variant.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

One variant of the panel: GRCh38 position and alleles, gene, consequence, impact, ClinVar significance, review status and conditions.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VARIANT_ID` | string |  | the VCF ID column, else CHROM-POS-REF-ALT |
| `CHROM` | string |  |  |
| `POS` | integer |  | 1-based position on the chromosome (GRCh38) |
| `REF` | string |  |  |
| `ALT` | string |  |  |
| `QUAL` | number |  |  |
| `FILTER` | string |  |  |
| `GENE` | string |  | INFO GENE |
| `CONSEQUENCE` | string |  | INFO CSQ (missense_variant, stop_gained ...) |
| `IMPACT` | string |  | INFO IMPACT: HIGH, MODERATE or LOW |
| `PROTEIN_POS` | integer |  | INFO AAPOS: the amino acid position (the lollipop's x) |
| `CARRIERS` | integer |  | samples with a non-reference genotype |
| `AF` | number |  | CARRIERS over the samples genotyped |
| `SAMPLES` | list |  | the carriers' sample ids |

The contract: `modules/genomics/packs/genomics/contracts/variant.yaml`
